name: Starter
description: The bundled reference theme — plain PHP templates, no build step. Copy it to make your own.

templates.layout: The HTML shell every page renders inside; includes header and footer.
templates.collection: A collection's live entries, newest first.
templates.404: Not-found page body; without it Nimbus serves a built-in one.

specialization: Add collection-{handle} or entry-{handle} (e.g. entry-homepage) to override the generic template for one collection; Nimbus falls back to the generic one.
assets: Files under assets/ are served at /theme/assets/<path> (e.g. assets/app.css -> /theme/assets/app.css). Allowlisted types only (css, js, images, fonts); no PHP.
